meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在分析项目历史时,会读取 claude-mem 记录的该项目完整时间线,生成“Journey Into [项目名]”叙事报告并保存为 markdown 文件,涵盖起源、架构演变、关键突破、调试过程、统计数据和经验教训等章节。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成时间线报告、分析项目开发历史、讲述项目故事等时触发。前提是 claude-mem worker 在运行且项目有观测记录。

say.text: 给 tokyo 项目写一份 Journey Into 报告
say.note: 会获取该项目完整时间线并生成叙事报告。

say.text: 分析 tokyo 项目的完整开发历程
say.note: 会执行时间线获取和子代理分析。

say.text: 生成这个项目的完整项目报告
say.note: 时间线超过 100K tokens 时会先询问是否继续。

howto.what_en: Claude fetches the project's full timeline from claude-mem and writes a markdown narrative report titled 'Journey Into [project]', covering origins, architecture evolution, breakthroughs, challenges, statistics, and lessons.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a timeline report, project history analysis, or a full project report, etc. Requires the claude-mem worker to be running and observations recorded for the project.

say_en.text: Write a Journey Into report for the tokyo project.
say_en.note: Fetches the full timeline and generates the narrative report.

say_en.text: Analyze the complete development history of tokyo.
say_en.note: Runs timeline fetch and subagent analysis.

say_en.text: Generate a full project report for tokyo.
say_en.note: Asks to confirm first if the timeline exceeds 100K tokens.
